title: Fallout 3 — FOS Header / Plugin-Environment Authentication Gate v3.2a
purpose: Authenticate each future T0/T1/T2/T3 input as a structurally valid Fallout 3 save header and freeze its plugin/load-order manifest before any runtime-state comparison. This gate deliberately stops at the body boundary and does not claim to decode ChangeForms, quest-state records or autobiographical-memory payloads.

post_magic_fields: uint32 file_version; Vortex implementation comments that this is always 0x30
FO3-vs-New-Vegas discriminator: bytes before the next 0x7c marker are 4 for FO3 and 5 for NV
five bytes skipped by Vortex as unknown byte plus plugin-data-size area
uint8 plugin_count followed by field-marker-delimited length-prefixed plugin names

outputs: cryptographic SHA-256 and byte size for each save
FO3 magic and structural discriminator result
plugin list and ordered plugin-manifest SHA-256
post-plugin body offset and remaining body byte count

t0_t3_authentication_rules.A0_FILE_HASH: Every input receives SHA-256 before parsing.
t0_t3_authentication_rules.A2_FO3_DISCRIMINATOR: Early pre-marker field size must be exactly 4; New Vegas-like size 5 is rejected.
t0_t3_authentication_rules.A3_FIELD_MARKERS: Every parsed marked scalar/string boundary must contain 0x7c exactly.
t0_t3_authentication_rules.A4_SCREENSHOT_BOUNDS: Screenshot dimensions must be within the Vortex guard and screenshot bytes must fit in the file.
t0_t3_authentication_rules.A5_PLUGIN_PARSE: Ordered plugin list must parse completely under the source-bound field-marker/string rules.
t0_t3_authentication_rules.A6_PLUGIN_ENVIRONMENT: T0/T1/T2/T3 must have identical ordered plugin manifests for strict differential admission unless a later artifact explicitly models a load-order intervention.
t0_t3_authentication_rules.A7_BODY_BOUNDARY: Bytes after plugin parsing are opaque body bytes in v3.2a and are never interpreted as ChangeForms or quest state here.

lineage_effect.what_v3_2a_can_prove: The compared saves are structurally Fallout 3-format inputs with frozen file identities and a directly comparable plugin environment.
what_v3_2a_cannot_prove: that the saves belong to the same player-character lineage solely from matching metadata
that any FormID raw-byte occurrence is a structured runtime reference
that MQDadRef or MQ04Doc has a ChangeForm
that any persisted engine state is an in-world memory backup
that any body bytes encode James autobiographical memory

critical_new_boundary.finding: The current Vortex Fallout 3 parser terminates its semantic parsing after save metadata, screenshot and plugin list; it does not expose a Fallout 3 ChangeForm/body decoder in the reviewed implementation files.
critical_new_boundary.effect: Do not inherit Skyrim/FO4 or community-described ChangeForm assumptions into Fallout 3. Open a separate v3.2b body-format gate and require primary implementation/spec evidence or controlled real-save reverse engineering before structured runtime claims.

next_gate.name: FALLOUT-3-FOS-BODY-CHANGE-STATE-FORMAT-EVIDENCE-GATE-v3.2b
next_gate.activation: Search for primary Fallout 3 body/change-record parsing implementation or derive a bounded structure from controlled real T0-T3 saves without borrowing unsupported formats from other Bethesda titles.
next_gate.promotion_condition: At least one independently verifiable parser/spec path must map a body byte range to a structured Fallout 3 quest/reference runtime record before v3.1 R1 can pass.
